parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, typically rectangular and attached to the front of the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet’s interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of plywood, forming the structural body that supports all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the door, drawer, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: This is the drawer component made of solid wood, located above the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a sliding compartment for storing smaller items, typically accessed by pulling the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet base made of plywood, forming the bottom support of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal operation.
